episodes.title: Il clan dei Savastano
episodes.summary: Ciro Di Marzio, right hand man of clan boss Pietro Savastano, and Ciro's fatherly friend Attilio set fire to Salvatore Conte's home to cut Salvatore down to size – him, the ruthless upcoming contender on the Savastano clan's turf.

episodes.title: Ti fidi di me?
episodes.summary: Ciro knows the time for revenge has not yet come, for the next major problem he has to deal with is always waiting around the corner. Like the bust of the Savastano cocaine shipment at the port of Naples where the whistleblower must be found.

episodes.title: L'omm 'e casa
episodes.summary: Behind bars in Poggioreale, the boss Pietro experiences the strict rules of the prison and the cruelty of the Commander. Meanwhile, Ciro and Genny manage the urgent business of the clan.

episodes.title: Sangue africano
episodes.summary: With Pietro gone, it is Imma who surprisingly starts to take care of business. With a couple of clever moves and a lot of courage she is suddenly in the pole position. Ciro has to take his orders from her now, with particular concern to her son Genny.

episodes.title: Il ruggito della leonessa
episodes.summary: Imma convinces Genny to go on a mission to the clan's drug-trafficking sources in Honduras, Ciro leaves for Spain. His assignment is to find Conte and negotiate a truce between the clans. Ciro returns to Naples only to realize nothing is as it was before.

episodes.title: Roulette spagnola
episodes.summary: Ciro realizes Imma had sent him away to pave her own road to power. Disapproving of the way she runs business, he sets up his own operation, to demean Imma's role within the clan. But Imma has learned quite well how to play the power-game herself.

episodes.title: Imma contro tutti
episodes.summary: It has become clear that Imma has Pietro's blessing and Ciro realizes that his strategy must once again be to toe the line while Imma starts to restructure the Savastano business empire. But things are bound to change when Genny returns from Honduras.

episodes.title: La scheda bianca
episodes.summary: Genny has strikingly changed and no longer needs his family or his mentor Ciro. He takes matters into his own hands. Keeping Ciro at a distance, Genny might just have to be careful when he demands subordination and loyalty. Does Ciro have a secret agenda?

episodes.title: Gelsomina Verde
episodes.summary: Genny plans to lead the gang towards a bright and prosperous future, but Ciro tries to stop this by sending someone to kill Salvatore Conte's right-hand man in Naples. Genny sends out word that he had nothing to do with the hit, fully aware of its potentially disastrous consequences: for him and the entire clan.

episodes.title: Ora facciamo i Conte
episodes.summary: Major bloodshed, if not all-out war, is imminent as Conte returns to Naples to avenge Giuliano's murder, and Ciro weaves his web further around Genny to distract him from the coup he is plotting. Imma receives a visit from Daniele's desperate mother, who begs her to spare her son's life - but Conte also has him in his sights.

episodes.title: 100 modi per uccidere
episodes.summary: Genny is cornered when the Savastanos' rivals rally around Conte to help exact revenge for Daniele's death, and he also faces trouble within his own ranks as a deadly battle erupts between his supporters and the old lieutenants. Imma is forced to intervene and manages to establish a fragile order within the clan, as well as realising that Ciro is behind this war.

episodes.title: Gli immortali
episodes.summary: War breaks out on the streets of Naples and Ciro flees to Rome with his wife and daughter as both clans barricade themselves in their apartment bunkers, entering into a lethal stalemate. Meanwhile, a vengeful Genny hunts down Ciro, intent on seeking justice for his betrayal.

episodes.title: Vita mia
episodes.summary: Pietro and Malamo take refuge in a warehouse in northern Italy; Ciro and Nano need money to buy a part of Conte's cocaine; Deborah falls apart under questioning.

episodes.title: Lacrime e sangue
episodes.summary: Genny visits his most valuable drug source in Honduras. During a trip to Cologne, Genny is faced with an unexpected reunion.

episodes.title: Mea culpa
episodes.summary: Genny and his father start something new after the disaster in Cologne. In Naples, Ciro and Salvatore take over the drug business from the previous owners: the Savastanos.

episodes.title: Profumo di iena
episodes.summary: The supposed end of the Savastanos Clan opens new doors for Ciro and Conte; Annalisa and Patrizia want to make their claim to power; Schianel visits his son in prison.

episodes.title: Occhi negli occhi
episodes.summary: Ciro organizes a parley with Gennaro to avoid a full-on gang war; Gennaro agrees, but with some strict orders from his father.

episodes.title: 'O Track
episodes.summary: With the peace talks in tatters, a new type of Camorrista emerges -- one not concerned about breaking time-honored traditions.

episodes.title: Il Principe e il Nano
episodes.summary: Determined to break up the alliance, Pietro decides to target O'Principe, since out of all the bosses, he is the most respected.

episodes.title: Divide et impera
episodes.summary: The alliance leaders blame O'Nano for the death of O'Principe. Ciro launches an investigation to ensure it was him before it's too late.

episodes.title: Sette anni
episodes.summary: Raffaele returns from prison after seven years and immediately takes over O'Principe's turf, leaving Genny's boys with a smaller cut.

episodes.title: Fantasmi
episodes.summary: Determined to defeat Pietro, Ciro shakes down Patrizia to find his hideout. Patrizia is desperate to prove her loyalty to Pietro.

episodes.title: Nella gioia e nel dolore
episodes.summary: With Pietro back in control, Ciro's allies are dwindling and he decides to go into hiding. Meanwhile in Rome, Genny and Azzurra prepare to wed.

episodes.title: La fine del giorno
episodes.summary: Pietro sets up a new method for dealing in order to maintain wealth. Genny awaits the birth of his first child, while Ciro prepares for war.

episodes.title: Viva il Re!
episodes.summary: Gennaro Savastano heads to Naples to warn Ciro ahead of time, there will be retribution for Don Pietro's murder.

episodes.title: Hasta la muerte
episodes.summary: After a year in Rome, Genny has made a success of Don Avitabile's business while he is in jail, but now Giuseppe has been released from prison.

episodes.title: Inferno
episodes.summary: Ciro has rebuilt his life in Bulgaria, where he is the trusted right-hand man of a drug dealer called Valentin. The Bulgarian criminals come to an agreement with the Napolitan camorra.

episodes.title: Il filo e la Moira
episodes.summary: Scianel is out of prison, and Genny knows he must confront her; Don Avitabile is also preparing for revenge against Genny.

episodes.title: Sangue Blu
episodes.summary: Under Ciro's wing, Enzo and his companions make waves with a big score; Genny looks to get back on his feet with a new supplier.

episodes.title: Come nascere
episodes.summary: Genny is back in a strong position thanks to the success of his new drug ventures; Ciro and Genny meet with Branka, a Milanese business partner, to buy new drugs.

episodes.title: Sangue del mio sangue
episodes.summary: Enzo launches new operations in Naples with Ciro's help; however, the traffic does not go unnoticed by the city's existing bosses.

episodes.title: Guerra aperta
episodes.summary: Enzo and his crew are under attack, but Ciro advises caution before retaliating; Genny approaches Scianel to help finance his own war.

episodes.title: Giuda!
episodes.summary: Ciro wants a ceasefire, but it doesn't come without a quid pro quo; Enzo can finally enjoy all he's achieved, but the good times don't last.

episodes.title: La creatura
episodes.summary: In an unwinnable position, Genny sends Patrizia to agree terms of surrender; he and Ciro go to Enzo, hoping he will listen to reason.

episodes.title: Fede
episodes.summary: With Azzurra and Pietrino in the crosshairs of the Confederati, Genny risks losing everything with a plan that could easily misfire.

episodes.title: Per sempre
episodes.summary: Ciro, Genny and Enzo agree to a treaty with the Confederati; however, peace achieved with blood carries only more blood.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: With Ciro dead and Naples set for an all-out war, Genny turns to a new and powerful player for help. Patrizia doesn't run into difficulties yet, but her peace will soon be shattered.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Genny reinvents himself as a businessman. However, when things get tough, he finds it impossible to keep his hands clean.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Gerlando Levante, Gennaro Savastano's uncle, manages to avoid a war with Sangue Blu; Genny is satisfied with the outcome and is pleased to be able to control Patrizia.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: The airport project takes Genny and Resta to London, where an unexpected event forces Genny to resort to criminal ways and confront the demons of his past.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: Patrizia is put to the ultimate test when the seizure of a huge shipment of cocaine threatens to throw the clans into war.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Nicola goes after the spy who shopped them as he tries to regain boss Patrizia's confidence. But lurking in the shadows is someone with a very different agenda.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.summary: The cocaine delay forces the Forcella boys to resort to desperate lengths to survive; Sangue Blu faces a leadership crisis.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.summary: A destructive chain of events sends Genny on a downward spiral into his past. While his business is plunged into the limelight, the entire airport project is at risk of going under.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.summary: The Capaccios strike out at Sangue Blu as they set out to conquer Forcella; Enzo risks not only losing his turf, but also his men's loyalty.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.summary: Having realized the cause of all of her misfortunes, Patrizia is forced to face up to a life-changing decision.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.summary: While Mickey is forced to make the ultimate choice between his family and the woman he loves, Genny starts to doubt his decision.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.summary: The time comes for everyone to make some big decisions, including deciding who will be left to rule Naples' smouldering ruins.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: After the head of a brutal Neapolitan crime organisation is imprisoned, his loyal right-hand man is obligated to protect the next in line.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: In Riga, Genny and Ciro are face to face again, but there is no time to talk. Ciro is in business with the Russians and now that Don Aniello is dead, a new broker is needed or the agreements will skip.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: While Ruggieri continues to investigate Genny, in Secondigliano the Levante are no longer popular. Genny tries to take back the neighborhood, but to do so, he needs a load of cocaine.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: The Levante and 'O Galantommo team up against Genny and the bosses of Secondigliano who passed with him. Genny, however, already has a counter move ready. Meanwhile, Ciro lets Genny know that he is back.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: The war has begun: as Ciro goes looking for new allies, Genny militarizes the streets and plants a mole within Ciro's ranks.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: Ciro and the others go underground in Forcella, but they have to find a safer place: Genny has put a bounty on them.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.summary: After yet another setback, Genny is forced to ask entrepreneurs for money in order to get back on his feet. In the meantime, Ciro and Nunzia receive an unexpected visit.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.summary: To win Ciro's competition, Genny forces his bosses to sell cocaine for half the price. The move seems to work, but Ciro also has something in store for Genny.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.summary: Genny is ready to go and pressures Ruggieri to find out where his son has been sent. Meanwhile, Ciro and Nunzia find new and unexpected allies willing to help them.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.summary: Genny has no choice: he must do what Ciro is ordering him to do. And so they set off on a final journey. Locked alone in the cockpit, they will be forced to face their demons.
